major_fixes.before: Numeric gate could retain exit code 0 even if port8012 verifier failed or was absent.
major_fixes.after: Numeric gate and entrypoint fail closed unless PORT_8012_WEB_ACCEPTANCE_PASSED is present with >=1036 rows.

major_fixes.before: 016 could be absent on clean repo; an early always-write variant could dirty/stash the receipt itself before exact-head verification.
major_fixes.after: Pre-recovery state is captured in memory and 016 is published only on receipt exit; dirty state is stashed only if it existed before recovery.

major_fixes.before: Port8012 verifier did not prove which three candidates were served.
major_fixes.after: Verifier requires rows 30762/46142/61522, candidate count 3, pending-web status and 1036 binding.
